English: SARS-CoV-2 genomic surveillance in Uganda provides an opportunity to provide a focused description of the virus evolution in a small landlocked East African country.
Luganda: Obulondoozi bwa SARS-CoV-2 mu Uganda butuwa omukisa okunnyonnyola obulungi akawuka ako mu nsi ya Afirika Buvanjuba mu Afirika.
Yoruba: SARS-CoV-2 ìṣàkíyèsí ìyídà àìsàn ní Uganda ṣe ìpèse àyè láti lè pèse àlá̀yé tó péye lórí ìdàgbàsókè aàrùn náà ní ilú ḱkeré tí ilẹ̀ yí ká ní apá ìlà oòrun Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ukubhekwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda kunikeza ithuba lokuchaza kahle ukuthi ngabe lishintshashintsha kanjani leli gciwane ezweni elivaliwe lase mpumalanga ne-Afrika.
Hausa: Sa-ido kan ƙwayoyin gadon SARS-CoV-2 a ƙasar Uganda yana ba da damar ba da cikakken bayanin juyin halittar ƙwayar cutar a wata ƙaramar ƙasa ta Gabashin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Diphatišišo tša tšenomiki tša SARS-CoV-2 ka nageng ya Uganda di fana ka sebaka sa go fana ka tlhalošo ye e nepilego ya tlhagelelo ya baerase go naga ye nnyane ye e dikaneditšwego ke dinaga tše dingwe ya ka Bohlabela bja Afrika.
Amharic: የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ጂኖሚያዊ ክትትል ወደብ የለሽ በሆነችው ትንሿ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሃገር ዩጋንዳ፣ በቫይረሱ ዝግመተ ለውጥ ላይ የሚያተኩር መግለጫ ለማቅረብ እድል ይሰጣል፡፡

English: Here we show a recent shift in the local epidemic with a newly emerging lineage A.23 evolving into A.23.1 which is now dominating the Uganda cases and has spread to 26 other countries.
Luganda: Wano, tulaga enneeyubula y’akawuka ka nawookeera akabuluseewo mu luse lwa A.23 nga kafuuse A.23.1 era kati kabuutikidde mu Uganda era nga kabunye mu mawanga amalala 26.
Yoruba: Níbí ni a ti ṣe àfihàn ìsún lórí I àjàkálẹ̀ aàr̀n náà lábẹ́lé pẹ̀lú irúfẹ́ ìtàn tuntun A.23 tí ó ń yí sínú u A.23.1 léyìí tó ń jẹ́ láboríaàrùn ní Uganda tó sì ti tàn ká sí orílẹ-ède 26 mìíran.
Zulu: Lapha sikhombisa ushintsho lwakamuva kulolu bhubhane lwendawo olunohlobo olusha oseluvele i-A.23 elushintsha lube yi-A.23.1 oludlangile ezweni lase-Uganda noselusabalalele emazweni anagama-26.
Hausa: A nan mun nuna wani sauyi na baya-bayan nan a cikin annoba ta gida tare da sabon zuriyar A.23 da ke tasowa zuwa A.23.1 wanda yanzu ya mamaye lamurran Uganda kuma ya bazu zuwa wasu ƙasashe 26.
Northern Sotho: Mo re bontšha phetogo ya bjale ya leuba la ka nageng ka lešika le le tšwelelago le le mpsha la A.23 le le hlagelelago go ba A.23.1 yeo gabjale e lego ketapele go malwetši a Uganda le gona e phatlaletšego go dinaga tše dingwe tše 26.
Amharic: እዚህ ጋር፣ አዲስ ብቅ ባለው እና ከA.23  ወደ A.23.1 በተለወጠው የትውልድ ሃረግ፣ አሁን ላይ የዩጋንዳን ሁነቶች በመቆጣጠር ላይ ያለውን እና ወደ 26 ሌሎች ሃገሮች የተሰራጨውን የኣካባቢ ወረርሽኝ የቅርብ ጊዜ ፈቀቅታ እናሳያለን፡፡

English: Although the precise changes in A.23.1 as it has adapted are different from the changes in the variants of concern (VOC), the evolution shows convergence on a similar set of proteins.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’enkyukakyuka mu A.23.1 nga bwe keefudde za njawulo ku nkyukakyuka mu njawulo za VOC, enfuukafuuka eyo eraga nti puloteyini ze zimu.
Yoruba: Wàyí o ìyípadà nínú u A.23.1 léyìí tó ti ń di mọ́lí yàtọ sí àwọn ìyípadà nínú irufẹ́ èyí tí ọ̀rọ́ kàn (VOC), ìdàgbàsókẹ̀ náà fi ìparapọ̀ lórí I ọ̀wọ́ purotéènì kan.
Zulu: Nakuba ushintsho oluqondile kwi-A.23.1 lukhona kepha luhlukile okunalolo olutholakala kuma-variant of concern (ama-VOC) nokuyiyo ekukhathazekwe ngenxa yayo.
Hausa: Ko da yake ainihin sauye-sauye a cikin A.23.1 kamar yadda ya dace ya bambanta da sauye-sauye a cikin nau’o’i na damuwa (VOC), juyin halittar yana nuna haɗuwa a kan nau’in furutoci irin waɗannan.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore diphetogo tša makgonthe go A.23.1 bjalo ka ge di fetošitšwe di fapana le diphetogo ka go mehuta ya tlhobaelo (VOC), phetogo e bontšha kopanyo go sete ye e swanago ya diprotheine.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ በ A.23.1 ውስጥ ያሉት ትክክለኛ ለውጦች፣ ከአስጊ-ልውጠቶች (አ.ል) ከወሰዳቸው ለውጦች የተለዩ ቢሆኑም ዝግመተ ለውጡ የተመሳሳይ ፕሮቲኖች ስብስብ መገጣጠምን ያሳያል፡፡

English: The A.23.1 spike protein coding region has accumulated changes that resemble many of the changes seen in VOC including a change at position 613, a change in the furin cleavage site that extends the basic amino acid motif, and multiple changes in the immunogenic N-terminal domain.
Luganda: Ekika kya puloteyini ya A.23.1 kikuŋŋaanyizza enkyukakyuka ezifaanagana n’enkyukakyuka mu VIC omwo nga mwe muli n’enkyukakyuka mu position 613, enkyukakyuka mu furin cleavage site eyongezaayo basic amino acid motif n’enkyukakyuka endala nnyingi mu immunogenic N-terminal domain.
Yoruba: A.23.1 náà ṣe ìrúsóke agbègbe purotéènì náà ti ó ń ́yídà léyìí tí ó jọ ọ̀pọ ìyíd̀à tí a rí nínú VOC pẹ̀lú ìyídà ipò ní 613, ìyídà ní agbègbe fúríìnì tí ó ṣe ìfikún fún àmínó asiìdì, àti ọ̀pọ̀ ìyídà nínú àká imunojẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì ìwa-N.
Zulu: I-A.23.1 spike protein coding region isiqoeqe izinguquko ezifuze izinguquko eziningi ezibonakala kwi-VOC, ukubala inguquko kwi-position 613, inguquko kwi-furin cleavage site enweba i-amino acid i-motif, kanye nezinguquko ezininingana kwi-immunogenic N-terminal domain.
Hausa: Yankin aikin furotin mai ƙaruwa na A.23.1 ya tara sauye-sauye waɗanda suka yi kama da yawancin sauye-sauyen da aka gani a cikin VOC ciki har da wani sauyi a matsayi na 613, sauyi a cikin wurin tsagewar furin wanda ya shimfiɗa tushen amino acid, da sauye-sauye da yawa a cikin immunogenic yankin N-terminal.
Northern Sotho: Karolo ya go khouta ya proteine ya sepaeke ya A.23.1 e kgobokeditše diphetogo tšeo di swanago le bontši bja diphetogo tše di bonwego go VOC go akaretša phetogo go maemo a 613, e lego phetogo ka lefelong la karoganyo yeo e katološago ntlha ye bohlokwa ya amino esiti, le diphetogo tše ntši ka go tomeine ya N-theminale ya imunotšeniki.
Amharic: የ A.23.1 ስፓይክ ፕሮቲን ኮድ የማድረጊያ ክልል አ.ል ውስጥ ከታዩት ብዙ ለውጦች ጋር የሚመሳሰሉ ብዝሃ ለውጦችን አከማችቷል፡፡ ይህም በቦታ 613 ላይ የተደረገ ለውጥን ጨምሮ መሰረታዊ የአሚኖ አሲድ ሞቲፍን የሚያራዝመው የፉሪን ስንጥቅ ቦታ ለውጥን እና በ ኤን-ተርሚናል ግዛት ላይ  በርካታ ለውጦችን አምጥቷል፡፡

English: In addition, the A.23.1lineage encodes changes in non-spike proteins that other VOC show (nsp6, ORF8 and ORF9).
Luganda: Ekirala, A.23.1 lineage ereetawo enkyukakyuka mu non-spike proteins eziragibwa VOC endala (nsp6, ORF8 and ORF9).
Yoruba: Láfikún, irúfẹ́ A.23.1 náà ní ìyídà lára àwọn purotéènì tí kò ń ṣe ìrúsókè tí àwọn VOC mìíran máa ń gbẹ́ yọ (nsp6, ORF8 àti ORF9).
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-A.23.1 lineage encodes iyashintsha kumaphrotheni angewona ama-spike aboniswa enye i-VOC (i-nsp6, ORF8 ne-ORF9).
Hausa: Har ila yau, zuriyar A.23.1 ya ƙunshi sauye-sauye a cikin furotoci marasa ƙaruwa waɗanda sauran VOC ke nunawa (nsp6 da ORF8 da kuma ORF9).
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, lešika la A.23.1 le fetoša diphetogo go diprotheine tše di se nago sepaeke tšeo di bontšhwago ke VOC tše dingwe (nsp6, ORF8 le ORF9).
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የA.23.1 የትውልድ ሃረግ በስፓይክ-ቢስ ፕሮቲኖች ውስጥ ሌሎች አ.ል የሚያሳዩትን ለውጦች (nsp6፣ ORF8 እና ORF9) ኮድ ያደርጋል፡፡

English: The clinical impact of the A.23.1 variant is not yet clear, however it is essential to continue careful monitoring of this variant, as well as rapid assessment of the consequences of the spike protein changes for vaccine efficacy.
Luganda: Ekintu A.23.1 ky’ekola tekinnaba kutegeerekeka bulungi, wabula, kikulu okugenda mu maaso n’okulondoola mu bwegendereza akawuka ako, wamu n’okukebera okw’amangu okw’ebyo ebiva mu puloteyini eyo kisobozese eddagala erigema okukola obulungi.
Yoruba: Ipa ìmọ́tótó irúfẹ́ ẹ A.23.1 náà kò tí ì hàn dáradára, ṣùgbọ́n ó ṣe pàtàkì kí a tẹ̀síwájú láti máa mójú tó ̀ẹ̀dà yìí, àti isègbéléwọ̀n àwọn aṣemáṣe irúsókè ìyídà purotéènì náa fún èsi àjẹsára tó tẹ̀wọ̀n tó.
Zulu: Umthelela we-A.23.1 awukacaci kahle, nokhpo kusemqoka ukuqhubeka kulawulwe loluhlobo lwegciwane, kanye nokuhlola okusheshayo kwemithelela kwezinguquko ze-spike protein ekusebenzeni ngendlela komgomo.
Hausa: Tasirin asibiti na nau’in A.23.1 bai riga ya fito fili ba, duk da haka yana da mahimmanci a ci gaba da lura da hankali da wannan nau’in, da kuma saurin kimanta sakamakon sauye-sauyen furotin mai ƙaruwa domin ingancin rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Kamego ya diteko tša kalafo tša mohuta wa A.23.1 ga se ya tšwa e kwagala gabotse, le ge go le bjalo go bohlokwa go tšwela pele go bea leihlo mohuta wo, gammogo le tekolo ya potlako ya ditlamorago tša diphetogo tša protheine ya sepaeke go go šoma ka tshwanelo ga moento.
Amharic: የA.23.1 ልውጠት ክሊኒካዊ ተጽእኖ ገና ግልጽ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ይህንን ልውጠት በጥንቃቄ መከታተል እና የስፓይክ-ፕሮቲን ለውጦች በክትባት ውጤታማነት ላይ የሚያስከትሉትን ተጽእኖ በፍጥነት መገምገም አስፈላጊ ነው፡፡

English: In 2021, researchers reported that a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes Covid-19, emerged in Uganda and spread to 26 other countries.
Luganda: Mu 2021 abanoonyereza baategeeza nti ekika kya SARS-CoV-2, akawuka akaleeta Covid-19 kaabalukawo mu Uganda era ne kasaasaanira ensi 26.
Yoruba: Ní 2021, àwọn olùṣèwádìí jábọ pé oríṣí ẹ̀dà tuntun SARS-CoV-2, aàrùn tó ṣokùnfa Covid-19, gbèrú ní Uganda tó sì tànká sí àwọn orílẹ̀-ède 26 mìíràn.
Zulu: Ngonyaka wezi-2021, abacwaningi babika ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwegciwane le-SARS-CoV-2, nokuyigciwane elibangela i-COVID-19, luvelile ezweni lase-Uganda labe selusabalalela emazweni amanye angama-26.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2021, masu bincike sun ba da rahoton cewa wani sabon nau'in SARS-CoV-2, ƙwayar cutar da take haifar da Covid-19, ta ɓulla a ƙasar Uganda kuma ta bazu zuwa wasu ƙasashe 26.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2021, banyakišiši ba begile gore mohuta o moswa wa SARS-CoV-2, e lego baerase ye e hlolago Covid-19, o hlagile go la Uganda wa phatlalala le dinaga tše dingwe tše 26.
Amharic: በ2021 ተመራማሪዎች እንደዘገቡት ኮቪድ-19ን የሚያመጣው አዲሱ ልውጠት ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2፣ ከዩጋንዳ ወጥቶ ወደ 26 ሌሎች ሃገሮች ተሰራጭቷል፡፡

English: They named the variant “A.23.1”, and said it has many of the same changes in proteins that researchers have observed in other variants of concern globally around this time.
Luganda: Akawuka ako baakatuuma “A.23.1”, era ne bagamba nti kalina enkyukyuka eziwera ezifaanagana mu puloteyini abanoonyereza ze baali beetegerezza mu bika ebirala okwetoolola ensi mu kiseera ekyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ ẹ̀dà náà ní “A.23.1”, wọ́n sì sọ pé ó ní ọ̀pọ àwọn ìyídà nínú u purotéènì tí àwọn olùṣèwádìí ti wòye nínú àwọn ẹ̀da èyí tí ọ̀rọ́ kàn lágbàáyé lásìkò yí.
Zulu: Babe sebenikeza leli gciwane igama bathi i-A.23.1 base bathi linezinguquko eziningi abazibonile kulezi ezinye iznhlobo zegciwane ezikhathaza umhlaba wonke.
Hausa: Sun sanya wa nau’in suna "A.23.1", kuma sun ce yana da sauye-sauye iri ɗaya a cikin furotoci da masu bincike suka lura a cikin wasu nau’o’in da suke damun duniya a wannan lokacin.
Northern Sotho: Ba theile mohuta wo leina la “A.23.1”, le go bolela gore bontši bja diphetogo tša ona bo swana le bja diprotheine tšeo banyakišiši ba di lemogilego go mehuta ye mengwe ya tlhobaelo lefaseng ka bophara mo nakong ye.
Amharic: ይህንን ልውጠት “A.23.1” ብለው ሰይመውታል፤ እንዲሁም ተመራማሪዎቹ  በዚህ ወቅት በአለም ዙሪያ በሌሎች አስጊ-ልውጠቶች ውስጥ በሚገኙ ፕሮቲኖች ላይ ያስተዋሏቸው ተመሳሳይ ለውጦች አሉት ብለዋል፡፡

English: Scientists track how coronavirus variants change so that they can better understand how well vaccines might work against new variants.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balondoola engeri ebika by’akawuka ka kolona gye bikyukakyuka basobole okutegeera obulungi eddagala erigema gye likola ku bika by’obuwuka obulala.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ń tọ pinpin bí ìyídà ṣe máa ń bá ẹ̀da àrun kòrónà láti lè jẹ́ kí wọ́n ní òye kíkún nípa bí àjẹsára ṣe lè bá ẹ̀dà tuntun náà jà.
Zulu: Ososayensi balandela ukuthi ngabe igciwane i-coronavirus ishintshashintsha kanjani ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono ukuthi imigomo ingasebenza kanjani ukulwisana nalezi zinhlobo ezintsha zegcinawe.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya suna bin diddigin yadda bambance-bambancen coronavirus ke sauyawa ta yadda za su iya fahimtar yadda rigakafin zai iya aiki sosai a kan sababbin nau’o’in.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di lota mohlala ka moo mehuta ya coronavirus e fetogago gore ba kgone go kwešiša bokaone ka moo meento e ka šomago bokaone twantšhong ya mehuta ye meswa.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ ክትባቶች በአዲሶቹ  ልውጠቶች ላይ ምን ያህል እንደሚሰሩ በተሻለ ሁኔታ ለመረዳት የኮሮና ቫይረስ ልውጠቶች እንዴት እንደሚቀያየሩ  ይከታተላሉ፡፡

English: Covid-19 has killed many people around the world.
Luganda: Covid-19 asse abantu bangi mu nsi.
Yoruba: Covid-19 ti pa ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: I-Covid-19 isibulele abantu abaningi emhlabeni wonke jikelele.
Hausa: Covid-19 ta kashe mutane da yawa a faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Covid-19 e bolaile batho ba bantši go ralala le lefase.
Amharic: ኮቪድ-19 በአለም ዙሪያ ብዙ ሰዎችን ገድሏል፡፡

English: In a process known as genomic surveillance, scientists monitor how the genetics and proteins of the virus changes as it spreads.
Luganda: Mu nkola emanyiddwa nga okulondoola ebikola endagabutonde, bannassaayansi balondoola engeri endagabutonde ne puloteyini z’akawuka nga bwe bikyukyukakyuka ng’akawuka kasaasaana.
Yoruba: Nínú ìlàkalẹ̀ ètò tí a mọ̀ sí ìṣàkíyèsí ìyídà àìsàn, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì máa ń mójú tó bí jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì àti purotéènì aàrùn náà ṣe ń tàn ká.
Zulu: Kwinqubo eyaziwa njenge-Genomic surveillance, ososayensi baqaphe ukuzthi ziguquka kanjani izakhifuzo zegciwane ngesikhathi lisabalala.
Hausa: A cikin wani tsari da aka fi sani da sa-ido ga ƙwayoyin gado, masana kimiyya suna lura da yadda ƙwayoyin gado da kuma furotoci na ƙwayar cutar suke sauyawa yayin da suke yaɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Go tshepedišo ye e tsebjago bjalo ka diphatišišo tša tšenomiki, ditsebi tša mahlale di bea leihlo ka moo ditlhamegotšini le diprotheine tša baerase di fetogago ge di phatlalala.
Amharic: የጂኖሚያዊ ክትትል ተብሎ በሚታወቀው ሂደት ውስጥ ሳይንቲስቶቹ የቫይረሱ ስነ ባህሪይ እና ፕሮቲኖች በስርጭቱ ወቅት እንዴት እንደሚለወጡ ይቆጣጠራሉ፡፡

English: They use this information to manage the disease and guide vaccine development.
Luganda: Bakozesa obubaka obwo okukola ku bulwadde era ne baluŋŋamya enkulaakulana y’eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Wọ́n máa ń lo àwọn ìròyìn wọ̀nyí láti lè mójú tó àìsàn àti láti fi ṣe ìtọ́nà fún ìdàgbàsókè àjẹsára.
Zulu: Basebenzisa ulwazi ukulawula lesi sifo ebese benika umhlahlandlela wokuthuthiukiswa komgomo.
Hausa: Suna amfani da wannan bayanin don sarrafa cutar da jagorantar samar da rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomiša tshedimošo ye go laola bolwetši le go hlahla go tšweletšwa ga moento.
Amharic: ይህን መረጃ በሽታውን ለመቆጣጠር እና የክትባት እድገትን ለመምራት ይጠቀሙበታል፡፡

English: For example, by understanding the structure of the virus’s spike proteins, researchers can design vaccines that better target those proteins to help prevent the virus from entering human cells.
Luganda: Okugeza, okutegeera enkula ya puloteyini y’akawuka, abanoonyereza basobola okukukola eddagala erigema eriruubirira puloteyini ezo okuyamba okuziyiza akawuka obutayingira mu butaffaali bwa muntu.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, nípa mímọ èto ìrú purotéènì aàrùn náà, àwọn olùṣèwádìí lè ṣẹ àwọn àjẹsára tí ó lè fojú sun àwọn purotéènì náà láti lè dẹ́kun aàrùn náà láti wọlé sínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì ara ènìyàn.
Zulu: Isibonelo, ngokuqonda ukuthi igciwane linhloboni futhi likanjani, abacwaningi bangakwazi ukusungula umgomo oqondene ngqo nalolo hlobo lwegciwane ukusiza ukuvimbela ukuthi igciwane likwazi ukungena emzimbeni womuntu.
Hausa: Misali, ta hanyar fahimtar tsarin furotoci masu ƙaruwa na ƙwayar cutar, masu bincike za su iya tsara alluran rigakafin da suka fi dacewa da waɗancan furotoci don taimakawa hana ƙwayar cutar shiga ƙwayoyin halitta na mutum.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, ka go kwešiša sebopego sa diprotheine tša sepaeke sa baerase, banyakišiši ba ka akanyetša meento yeo e nepago bokaone diprotheine tšeo go thuša go thibela baerase gore e se tsene go disele tša motho.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የቫይረሱን ስፓይክ-ፕሮቲኖች አወቃቀር በመረዳት ተመራማሪዎቹ ቫይረሱ ወደ ሰው ሴሎች እንዳይገባ ለመከላከል እነዚያ ፕሮቲኖች ላይ የሚያነጣጥሩ ክትባቶችን መንደፍ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: In this study, researchers looked specifically at how SARS-CoV-2 was evolving in Uganda.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baatunuulira naddala engeri akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 gye kaali kakyukakyukamu mu Uganda.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, awọn olùṣèwádìí tọ pinpin bí SARS-CoV-2 ṣe ń lọ ní orílẹ̀-ède Uganda.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke ngokukhethekile ekutheni i-SARS-Co-V-2 ibishintshashinstha kanjani ezweni lase-Uganda.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun duba musamman yadda SARS-CoV-2 ke tasowa a ƙasar Uganda.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba lebeletše kudukudu ka moo SARS-CoV-2 e bego e fetoga ka gona ka nageng ga Uganda.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎች ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 በተለይ በዩጋንዳ ውስጥ እንዴት እየተለወጠ እንደመጣ አስተውለዋል፡፡

English: Researchers determined the genetic sequences of the virus in COVID-19 positive samples collected throughout Uganda.
Luganda: Abanooneyreza baalaba ensengeka y’akawuka mu sampolo ezirimu COVID-19 mu Uganda yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí pinu àwọn ète ìṣàfihàn jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì aàrùn inú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ tí a gbà sílẹ̀ lára àwọn tí ó ní aàrun COVID-19 káàkiri Uganda.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo lwegciwane esifeni se-COVID-19 kumasampula aqoqwe ezweni lase-Uganda.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun tantance jerin kwayoyin gado na cutar a cikin samfuran waɗanda suka kamu da COVID-19 da aka tattara a cikin ɗaukacin ƙasar Uganda.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba laeditše ditatelantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tša baerase go disampole tše di nago le phetetšo ya COVID-19 tše di kgobokeditšwego nageng ya Uganda ka bophara.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከመላው ዩጋንዳ ከተሰበሰቡ የኮቪድ-19 ፖዘቲቭ ናሙናዎች የጄኔቲክ ዋነኛ አወቃቀሮችን ወስነዋል፡፡

English: They used computer software to trace the lineage (or family history) of the new variant they identified in this way (called A.23.1), and were able to see where the variant fit into the SARS-CoV-2 family tree.
Luganda: Baakozesa software wa kompyuta okulondoola olunyiriri (obujjajja) bw’akawuka akapya ke baazuula mu ngeri eyo (akayitibwa A.23.1), era nga baasobola okulaba akawuka ako we keeyunga mu lunyiriri n’obujjajja bwa SARS-CoV-2.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo àwọn ẹ̀rọ kọ̀m̀pútà láti tọ pinpin ẹbí (tàbí ìtàn ìdílé) ti ẹ̀dà tuntun tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ dámọ̀ (tí a pè ní A.23.1), wọ́n sì rí ibi tí ẹ̀dà náà wà lára igi ìdílé SARS-CoV-2.
Zulu: Basebenzise ikhompuyutha ukulandela ukuthi ngabe luvela kuphi lolu hlobo olusha lwegciwane i-A.23.1 babe sebekwazi ukubona ukuthi loluhlobo luhlobana kanjani nohlobo lwe-SARS-CoV-2.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da manhaja ta kwamfuta domin gano zuriyar (ko tarihin iyali) na nau’in da suka gano ta wannan hanyar (wanda ake kira A.23.1), kuma sun sami damar ganin inda bambance-bambancen ya dace da bishiyar dangin SARS-CoV-2.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše softewere ya khomphutha go lota mohlala wa lešika (goba histori ya lapa) ya mohuta o moswa wo ba o hlaotšego ka tsela ye (wo o bitšwago A.23.1), le gona ba kgonne go bona moo mohuta o welago gona go lešika la SARS-CoV-2.
Amharic: በዚህ መንገድ የለዩትን (A.23.1 ተብሎ የሚጠራውን) አዲሱን ልውጠት የትውልድ ሃረግ ( ወይም የቤተሰብ ታሪክ) ለመከታተል የኮምፒውተር ሶፍትዌር ተጠቅመዋል፤ እና ልውጠቱ በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 የዘር ሃረግ ውስጥ የቱ ጋር  እንደሚገባ ለማየት ችለዋል፡፡

English: Their results showed that the A.23.1 variant recently evolved from another variant called A.23, and was detected in 90% of all positive samples.
Luganda: Bye baazuula birala nti A.23.1 kaava mu kalala A.23, era nga baakakenga mu sampolo ezirimu obulwadde eziwera 90%.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsi wọ́n fi hàn pé ẹ̀da A.23.1 jẹ́ ìyídà ẹ̀dà mìíràn tí í ṣe A.23, tí a rí nínú 90% àwọn àpẹẹrẹ àgbàsílẹ̀ àwọn tí ó ní aàrùn náà.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi igciwane i-A.23.1 lusanda kuguquka lusuka kuhlobo lwe-A.23, futhi lolu hlobo lutholakale kumasampula angamaphesenti angama-90% athathiwe.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa bambance-bambancen A.23.1 kwanan nan ya samo asali ne daga wani bambance-bambancen da ake kira A.23, kuma an gano shi a cikin kashi 90% na duk samfuran waɗanda suka kamu.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di bontšhitše gore mohuta wa A.23.1 o fetogile go tšwa go mohuta o mongwe wo o bitšwago A.23, le gona o lemogilwe go 90% tša disampole ka moka tše di nago le phetetšo.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው A.23.1 ልውጠት በቅርብ ጊዜ A.23 ከተባለ ከሌላ ልውጠት የመጣ እና 90% በሚሆኑት በሁሉም ፖዘቲቭ ናሙናዎች ውስጥ የተገኘ መሆኑን ያሳያል፡፡

English: In other words, it had dominated Ugandan samples since October 2020.
Luganda: Kwe kugamba, kaali kabnye mu sampolo z’omu Uganda okuva mu Gwekkumi 2020.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀nà ìgbàsọ mìíràn, ó ti jẹ gàba lórí àwọn àpẹẹrẹ àgbàsílẹ àwọn ẹni tí ó ní aàrùn náà ní Uganda láti oṣù Ọ̀wàwà ọdún 2020.
Zulu: Ngamanye amazwi, beludlange kakhulu kumasampula ase-Uganda kusuka ngonyaka wezi-2020.
Hausa: A taƙaice dai, ta mamaye samfuran Uganda tun watan Oktoba na shekarar 2020.
Northern Sotho: Ka mantšu a mangwe, e laotše disampole tša Uganda go tloga ka Oktobere 2020.
Amharic: በሌላ አነጋገር ከኦክቶበር 2020 ጀምሮ የኡጋንዳን ናሙናዎች ተቆጣጥሮ ነበር፡፡

English: They also found that the A.23.1 variant had several changes in the spike protein similar to changes seen in other variants of concern.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti ekika kya A.23.1 kaalimu enkyukakyuka nnyingi mu puloteyini (spike protein) okufaananako ng’enkyukakyuka ezaalabikira mu bika ebirala ebyogerwako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé ẹ̀ya A.23.1 náà ní ìyídà lóríṣiríṣi nínú ìrú purotéènì tí ó fara pẹ́ ìyídà tí a máa ń rí nínú àwọn ẹ̀ya irúfẹ́ èyí tí à ń sọ.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi i-A.23.1 inezinguquko ezithize ezifana nalezo ezitholakala kwezinye izinhlobo zegciwane.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma gano cewa bambance-bambancen A.23.1 yana da sauye-sauye da yawa a cikin furotin mai ƙaruwa mai kama da sauye-sauyen da aka gani a wasu bambance-bambancen na damuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore mohuta wa A.23.1 o be o na le diphetogo tše mmalwa ka go protheine ya sepaeke ye e swanago le diphetogo tše di bonwego go mehuta ye mengwe ya tlhobaetšo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የA.23.1 ልውጠት በሌሎች አስጊ-ልውጠቶች ላይ እንደታየው አይነት ለውጦች በስፓይክ-ፕሮቲኖች ውስጥ ብዙ ለውጦች እንደነበረው ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: The changes likely makes the variant more transmissible (it spreads faster), and more resistant to vaccines and treatments.
Luganda: Enkyukakyuka ezo ziraka nti zifuula ekika ekyo okuba nga zisaasaana (kasaasaana mangu), era nga kagumira eddagala erigema n’obujjanjabi obulala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìyídà náà lè jẹ́ kí ẹ̀yà náà ní àkóràn (ìtànkálẹ̀ rẹ̀ yára), àti kó sì máa gbógun ti abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára àti ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Lezi zinguquko zenza lolu hlobo lwegciwane ukuthi lusabalale kalula ukunezinye izinhlobo, ebese luphinde lukwazi ukumelana nomgomo neminye imishanguzo yokulwisana nalo.
Hausa: Sauye-sauyen na iya sa bambance-bambancen ya zama mai saurin yaɗuwa (yana yaɗuwa cikin sauri), kuma ya fi juriya ga alluran rigakafi da kuma jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Diphetogo di ka baka kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore mohuta o phatlaletšege gabonolo (o phatlalale ka lebelo), le go retelela meento le dikalafo kudu.
Amharic: ለውጦቹ ልውጠቱን የበለጠ ተላላፊ (በፍጥነት የሚሰራጭ) እና ለክትባቶች እና ለህክምናዎች የበለጠ ተቋቋሚ ሊያደርጉት ይችላሉ፡፡

English: This study adds to ongoing efforts to sequence SARS-CoV-2 variants globally.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwongereza kaweefube w’okusengeka ebika bya SARS-CoV-2 mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí fi kún akitiyan tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ láti kápá ẹ̀ya SARS-CoV-2 lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwengeza koselwenziwe ukukwazi ukuqanda igciwane i-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni jikelele.
Hausa: Wannan binciken yana ƙari ne ga ƙoƙarin ci gaba domin jera bambance-bambancen SARS-CoV-2 a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di tlaleletša go maitekelo a bjale a go latelanya mehuta ya SARS-CoV-2 lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ልውጠቶችን ዋነኛ አወቃቀር ለመለየት በሚደረገው አለም-አቀፋዊ ጥረት ላይ ግብአት ይጨምራል፡፡

English: The results add to growing evidence that SARS-CoV-2 rapidly evolves as it spreads to infect more people and evade vaccines.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa byongereza ku bubaka obweyongera okufunibwa nga bulaga nti SARS-CoV-2 akyukakyuka mu bwangu nga bw’asaasaana n’okukwata abantu abawera ate n’okwewoma eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Èsì náà fi kún ẹ̀rí pé SARS-CoV-2 ń dàgbà nínú ìyídà si bí ó ti ń tànkálẹ̀ láti mú àwọn ènìyàn àti láti bọ́ lọ́wọ́ agbára abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára.
Zulu: Imiphumela yengeza kubufakazi obukhulayo obuveza ukuthi igciwane i-SARS-CoV-2 liguquka ngokushesha ngenkathi lisabalala ukuthelela abantu abaningi libe ligwema umgomo.
Hausa: Sakamakon yana ƙara shaida mai girma cewa SARS-CoV-2 tana haɓaka da sauri yayin da take yaɗuwa domin kama mutane da kumwa gujewa rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di tlaleletša go bohlatse bjo bo golelago pele bja gore SARS-CoV-2 e fetoga ka lebelo ge e le gare a phatlalala go fetela batho ba bantši le go efoga meento.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ብዙ ሰዎችን እየበከለ እና ክትባቶችን እያመለጠ በሚሰራጭበት ጊዜ በፍጥነት ስለመቀያየሩ እያደጉ በመጡት ማስረጃዎች ላይ ግብአቶችን ይጨምራሉ፡፡

English: However, more research is needed to understand what exactly the effects or functions of spike protein changes in the A.23.1 variant would be.
Luganda: Wabula, okunoonyereza okulala kwetaagisa okusobozesa okutegeera okukosebwa kwennyini n’omulimu gw’enkyukakyuka ya spike protein mu A.23.1.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí gbọ́dọ̀ tẹ̀síwájú láti ní òye ohun tí ìyídà ìrú purotéènì A.23.1 yóò jẹ́.
Zulu: Nokho, ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi imiphi imiphumela noma imisebenzi ye-spike protein eguqukayo kokuhluka kwe-A.23.1 kungaba.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike don fahimtar mene ne ainihin tasirin ko ayyukan sauye-sauyen furotin mai ƙaruwa a cikin nau’in A.23.1 zai kasance.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, go hlokega dinyakišišo tše ntši go kwešiša thwii gore diabe goba mešomo ya diphetogo tša diprotheine tša sepaeke go mohuta wa A.23.1 e ka ba dife.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በA.23.1 ልውጠት ውስጥ የስፓይክ-ፕሮቲኖች ተጽእኖ እና አገልግሎት በትክክል ምን እንደሆነ ለመረዳት ተጨማሪ ምርምር ያስፈልጋል፡፡

English: The researchers recommend more genomic surveillance to help us understand how virus variants respond to vaccines available in Uganda and other countries.
Luganda: Abanooneyereza basemba okulondoola okulala ku nsengeka y’ebikola endagabutonde okuyamba mu kutegeera engeri ebika by’akawuka gye bikolebwako eddagala erigeam eriri mu Uganda ne mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà gbóríyìn fún ọ̀pọ ìṣàkíyèsí ìyídà àìsàn láti lè fún wa ní òye bí àwọn ẹ̀dà aàrun náà ṣe ń fèsì sí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára tó wà ní Uganda àti àwọn orílè-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baenza izincomo zokubhekwa kwe-genome ukusisiza siqonde ukuthi izinhlobo zegciwane ziphathwa kanjani umgomo otholakala ezweni lase-Uganda kanye nalowo otholakala kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar ƙarin sa-ido a kan ƙwayoyin halitta domin taimaka mana fahimtar yadda bambance-bambancen ƙwayoyin cuta suke amsa alluran rigakafin da ake samu a ƙasar Uganda da sauran ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore go dirwe diphatišišo tše ntši tša tšenomiki go re thuša go kwešiša ka moo mehuta ya dibaerase e iphemelago go meento ye e hwetšagalago ka Uganda le dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የቫይረሱ ልውጠቶች በኡጋንዳ እና በሌሎች ሃገሮች ላሉት ክትባቶች እንዴት ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ ለመረዳት ተጨማሪ የጂኖሚያዊ ክትትል ማድረግን ይመክራሉ፡፡

English: They also say monitoring international travel is important so that researchers can better understand how the virus circulates locally.
Luganda: Era bagamba nti okulondoola entambula y’abantu mu nsi yonna kukulu kisobozese abanoonyereza okutegeera obulungi engeri akawuka gye kasaasaanamu mu kitundu ekimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì sọ pé mímú ojú tó ìrìn-àjò onílùú-sí-ìlú ṣe pàtàkì latì lè fún àwọn olùṣèwádìí ní òye bí àrun náà ṣe ń tànkálẹ̀ lábẹ́lé.
Zulu: Bathi futhi ukuqapha uhambo lwamazwe ngamazwe kusemqoka ukuze abacwaningi bezoqonda kagcono ukuthi ngabe igciwane lizungeza kanjani endaweni.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce sanya ido a kan tafiye-tafiyen ƙasashen duniya yana da muhimmanci ta yadda masu bincike za su ƙara fahimtar yadda ƙwayar cutar take yaɗuwa a cikin gida.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gape gore go bea leihlo mosepelo ya boditšhabatšhaba go bohlokwa gore banyakišiši ba kgone go kwešiša bokaone ka moo baerase e phatlalalago ka gona ka nageng.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ተመራማሪዎቹ ቫይረሱ በሃገር ውስጥእንዴት እንደሚዘዋወር በበለጠ መረዳት ይችሉ ዘንድ አለም አቀፍ ጉዞዎችን በቅርበት መከታተል አስፈላጊ ነው ይላሉ፡፡
